projects.name: Move to the Bradford office
projects.goal: All 40 staff working from Bradford by the end of next quarter
projects.summary: The Leeds lease ends next year. Survey and design are done; the network is being built now, then move day.
projects.business_case:
The Leeds lease ends next year and renewing it costs more than the move.

Benefits: one site instead of two, room to grow, and a modern network with no legacy kit.
Costs: cabling and switches (quoted), two days of disruption on move day.
Main risks: kit delivery and landlord access - both in the RAID log.

tasks.title: Quarterly access review for privileged accounts
tasks.description:
Review all members of Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, and the Tier 0 PIM group. Confirm with line managers that elevated rights are still required, and remove anyone who has changed role.

Output: signed-off spreadsheet stored in IT Compliance SharePoint.

tasks.title: Replace failed UPS battery in main server room
tasks.description: UPS-A2 reported battery failure on Sunday. Replacement battery pack arrived Monday. Schedule a 30-minute window to swap and run a self-test.

tasks.title: Roll out new GlobalProtect VPN client (v6.3)
tasks.description: Phased rollout of the new VPN client to all staff laptops. Old client to be retired by end of month.

tasks.title: Renew SSL certificate for portal.example.com
tasks.description: Wildcard cert *.example.com expires in 9 days. Generate CSR, request renewal from DigiCert, install on the load balancer and verify chain.

tasks.title: Document the new MFP install process
tasks.description: Write up the deployment process for the Konica C300i fleet - driver source, IP reservation, follow-me print queue setup. Publish to KB.

tasks.title: Onboarding - Karen Hall (Marketing, starts Monday)
tasks.description: New starter Karen Hall joins the Marketing team next Monday. Standard onboarding: account, mailbox, laptop, security groups, induction.

tasks.title: Migrate file shares to SharePoint (Phase 2 - Finance & HR)
tasks.description:
Phase 2 of the file share retirement project. Finance (480 GB) and HR (210 GB) shares to be migrated to dedicated SharePoint sites with the same NTFS-equivalent permissions.

Phase 1 (IT and Marketing) completed last month.

tasks.title: Refresh laptop SOE image - Windows 11 24H2
tasks.description: Build the next-gen Standard Operating Environment image based on Windows 11 24H2. Includes corporate apps, security baseline, and updated branding.

tasks.title: Decommission legacy Citrix farm
tasks.description: Now that Azure Virtual Desktop is the strategic remote-access platform, the legacy Citrix XenApp 7.15 farm can be retired. Power down session hosts, reclaim VLAN/IPs, and notify Finance to cancel licences.

tasks.title: Audit shared mailboxes for stale accounts
tasks.description: Identify shared mailboxes with no logins in the last 90 days. Confirm with owning department, then archive and remove.

tasks.title: Run quarterly phishing simulation campaign
tasks.description: Q1 phishing simulation via KnowBe4. Three templates targeted at Finance, Sales, and All Staff. Compile results and feed into the security awareness report.

tasks.title: Replace boardroom 2 conference display
tasks.description: Old Samsung 65" panel had repeated HDMI handshake failures. Replaced with a Logitech Rally Bar Mini and a new 75" LG display. Tested with Teams Rooms.

task_comments.comment: Account and mailbox done. Laptop ordered from Lenovo, ETA Thursday. Will ship straight to her home address.
Laptop arrived this morning - imaging now. Should be out for delivery tomorrow.
Finance pilot kicked off Monday. 240 GB synced overnight. Hit one issue with a 12-level nested folder structure that breached SharePoint path limits - flattened it with the team's blessing.
Good catch on the path-length issue. Worth adding that to the runbook before HR's turn.
CSR generated. DigiCert order placed - waiting on validation email to the abuse@ alias. Setting reminder for tomorrow if it hasn't landed.
All published apps now live in AVD. Citrix usage telemetry shows 4 sessions in the last 7 days - tracking those users down individually before we power off.
Final results: 14% click rate (down from 22% last quarter), 3% credential entry (down from 7%). Awareness training is paying off. Full report uploaded to the security folder.
Found 11 stale shared mailboxes - 7 archived, 3 retained at owner's request, 1 already deleted. Sign-off attached.
